# Run Shortcut

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Runs the given shortcut.

## Syntax

~~~~text
runShortcut(name: <#String or Number (Allows Variables)#>, input: <#Variable (Optional)#>, show: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
runShortcut(name: "Jellycuts Helper", input: ShortcutInput, show: false)
~~~~
